integrity: The unrestricted claim is analytically proved; 510 exact rational heat instances and 14846 independently optimized pair transports were checked as finite corroboration. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted one-hub unions of clique blades, combinatorial heat flow, and original graph-metric W1 are covered.
Weighted, normalized, multi-articulation, and other-Wasserstein-exponent extensions are not asserted.
Earlier infinitesimal variation threshold and star norm are not claimed to be novel.
Absolute publication priority cannot be established by bounded literature searches.
title: Exact all-time heat transport and smallest-petal rigidity for clique bouquets
